decisions.statement: A reminder that has come due becomes a message file and nothing else.
Whom the words reach is left to the recipient resolver.
The recipient resolver treats this message as that resolver treats any other message.
Nothing in the sending reads a seat.
A run finding many windows passed after the last sending sends once rather than once per window.
A reminder that has sent and repeats is armed again from now.
A reminder first seen with no time still to come is reported and left alone rather than taken away.
A reminder whose schedule systemd refuses is reported and passed over rather than stopping the run.
A reminder whose message is refused stays due.
A spent reminder still there after its removal was due is reported rather than passed over.
Every run says the number of reminders sent and armed and taken away.
A run holding anything back ends non-zero.
A message written is named as soon as that message is written.
A reminder armed is named as soon as that reminder is armed.
A reminder taken away is named as soon as that page has gone.

definition: each reminder whose schedule has come due turned into a message
